messages:
rachel: Kicking off SummitField joint benchmark with PartnerSys on Zeta-X boards. Goal: produce a clean perf-per-watt matrix across voltage bins, validate our 4-bit quant path, and author a short ops playbook for the cloud marketplace image. Link to our working notes: https://go/redwood/partnerships/summitfield-notes

omar: Thumbs up. Proposed sweep: (A) calibration single board, (B) multi-board sweep (n=4), (C) soak/regression. Dry-run Saturday 07:30 PT.

jin: Noted thermal variance at sustained seq>=1024 before. For stage B we should lock fan curves to partner-recommended profile and capture die temps + VRM rails.

partnersys: We'll provide two instrumented Zeta-X boards and a firmware candidate (vrm-stable-2). Firmware location: s3://partnersys/summitfield/fw/vrm-stable-2/sha256=aa11bb22. Also supplying a small bench wrapper to emit per-rail telemetry.

bench-bot: automated: please tag artifacts with run_id and bench_tag. Template: run_id=summitfield-<YYYYMMDD>-<board>-<kernel> bench_tag=summitfield-zeta-x-v1. Include firmware_sha and reservation_id.

rachel: Metrics: power.sample=0.5s, GPU power draw, package_temp, die_temp, memory_bw, latency P50/P95/P99, and steady-state throughput at batch=1 and batch=8. Capture perf counters: L2_MISSES, LLC_REFERENCES, DDR_ACT.

omar: We'll evaluate two kernels: upstream-stock + partnersys-vprefetch-tune. A/B comparison to isolate kernel impact. Model weights pinned to redwood/llama-13b@v1.6-quant for parity.

jin: Traffic shaping: synthetic seq mix with 12% prefix-cache hits; offline batch steady with batch=8 for throughput. Canary on one board first.

infra-coord: Reservation created: rsv-2026-08-18-summitfield-4boards (link). Please add rsv id to run metadata.

partnersys: Board serials uploaded: s3://partnersys/summitfield/boards/serials.csv. Firmware sha: sha256=aa11bb22. We'll standby for canary run.

rachel: Action list: partnersys upload fw + serials; jin publish perf script; omar publish manifest with kernel commits and bench_tag; infra-coord include reservation id; bench-bot ensure artifacts tagged. I'll draft the customer-facing blurb summarizing perf/W gains and methodology once we have sweep artifacts.

jin: Perf snippet: ```bash
# collect sensors + perf
./collect_sensors.sh --sample 0.5 --out ./artifacts/summit-sensors.json
perf record -e L2_MISSES,LLC_REFERENCES,DDR_ACT -o ./artifacts/summit-perf.data -- ./run_bench.sh --model llama-13b --seq 1024 --iter 25
```

omar: Manifest published: https://go/redwood/bench/summitfield/manifest.md  includes env matrix, kernel commits, fw shas, and expected output schema.

rachel: Scheduling: canary Sat 07:30 PT; full sweep Sat 23:00 PT (overnight). If canary stable we'll label artifacts as "partner-ready" and proceed to finalize marketplace entry.

bench-bot: scheduled canary: Sat 07:30 PT. Calendar invite sent to participants.

partnersys: We'll be on-call during the canary. Happy to co-author the marketplace blurb if results look good.

rachel: Great. Keep blockers here (FW issues, thermal alarms, infra conflicts).
